    def test_apply_po_auto_approves_under_threshold_and_emails_vendor_immediately(
        isolated_stores, mock_mail, rag_module
    ):
        """
        KNOWN BUG (as of this writing): apply_po() saves the record with
        status="auto_approved" and THEN calls approve_po_request(id) to
        send the vendor email - but approve_po_request() refuses to act
        on any request whose status isn't "pending", so it immediately
        rejects itself with "That request is already auto_approved." The
        vendor is silently never emailed on an auto-approved PO. This
        test encodes the CORRECT behavior and will fail until apply_po()
        is fixed to either set status="pending" before calling
        approve_po_request(), or send the vendor email directly instead
        of routing through approve_po_request().
        """
        rag_module.PO_AUTO_APPROVE_THRESHOLD = 5000.0  # our 1000 PO qualifies
    
        ok, message, details = rag_module.apply_po(
            "kishore", "Dell", "engineering", _basic_po_items(),
            vendor_email="vendor@test.local",
        )
    
        assert ok is True, message
        record = details["record"]
        assert record["status"] == "auto_approved"
    
        # Auto-approval should have driven the SAME vendor-notification
        # path as a manual approve - the vendor really got emailed, with
        # no separate approval step required.
